sprint: BACKLOG.md item 1 -- Restore Loses Orientation (root Studio only)
task: Started a new backlog-driven workflow: 'start with 1 and 4 for now,' referring to BACKLOG.md items 1 (this fix) and 4 (Performance with 20+ objects, still pending). Item 1, verbatim: 'When restore is clicked in studio, the project looses its orignal orientation. i was authoring a project in landscape mode. i hard refreshed the page and on clicked on restore, the scene came back as a portrait mode. when i clicked home went into projects and reopened the project it came back as landscape as it was supposed to be.' Root cause, confirmed via direct code reading and a decisive git-stash A/B reproduction: js/themeRegistry.js's in-memory theme catalog is wiped clean by every hard reload, and only _startCreationFlow()'s own boot path (never the restore-modal boot path) ever re-fires refreshFromRepository()/rehydrateRedeemed() to repopulate it. The restore-modal's Restore button calls ProjectManager.restoreSession()->deserialize()->ThemeEngine.applyArtworkTheme(), whose resolution line silently drops the theme id to null the instant ThemeRegistry.hasTheme(id) is false -- which, on this boot path, it always is for an Official-Repository-backed World -- falling AppState.project.artworkTheme to null and the render pipeline's theme/layout resolution chain to its default portrait viewport. Confirmed specific to Artwork Theme resolution (applyTheme's own Story-Theme mechanism falls back to a FALLBACK_THEME shape instead of nulling), justifying the fix's gating scope. Fix, in two steps: an initial unconditional fix (await the repository-refresh promise before restoreSession() runs) was verified via git-stash A/B to genuinely resolve the bug, but introduced up to ~4s of latency on every Restore click including the common Story-Theme-only case with nothing at risk -- a real, confirmed regression against the user's own separately-stated 'no jittery sessions' constraint, caught by a second Playwright suite whose own fixed wait window raced against and lost to the new delay. Refined, shipped fix: gate the await on needsWorldRefresh=!!(info.data.project.artworkTheme) -- only wait when the saved session actually carries an Artwork Theme reference; both background-firing refresh calls remain unconditional regardless of the gate. Verified: bug1_orientation_repro.js (a real, on-disk Museum Gallery .vtheme reachable only via a mocked, artificially-delayed Official Repository -- authors a real landscape page, forces a save, performs a genuine page.reload(), drives the real restore-modal UI) 9/9 passing, confirming both canvas orientation and AppState.project.artworkTheme correctly restored. restore_discard_bugs_abc_verify.js (an existing diagnostic suite, including 'Bug C2' -- a genuine deserialize() exception must never discard the saved session) re-run twice: first run 22/24 with one isolated, unrelated failure traced to a documented, pre-existing Gateway-skip-timing flakiness class (per the suite's own doc comment); immediate re-run 24/24 clean, confirming the failure was pre-existing flakiness, not a regression. restore_discard_fix_verify.js 12/12 unaffected. welcome_heading_removed_verify.js initially failed on a documented, pre-existing missing-test-server infrastructure gap unrelated to this fix; resolved by starting a real server on the hardcoded port, then 4/4 passing. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero impact on either Builder-tooling surface. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/app.js.
